notes: Release 2 of the portfolio restructure, and nothing on the screen changes. What changes is that the eight sub-pages stopped depending on where they are. Every one of them read state.pf.sel and state.pf.period directly. That is the shape that cannot become a panel: a renderer which reaches for the CURRENT selection can only ever draw the current selection, so two portfolios side by side would both render whichever was selected last.
